title: [ARKNIGHTS X SANRIO CHARACTERS] TENDER MOMENTS COLLAB EVENT OPEN
lines: 01 [ARKNIGHTS X SANRIO CHARACTERS] TENDER MOMENTS COLLAB EVENT OPEN
DURATION: March 6, 2026, 08:00 - March 27, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can log in to claim rewards, including Event Exclusive Furniture, Materials, and Furniture Part.
Phase 1
STARTS: March 6, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7)
CONTENTS: Event Exclusive Furniture 'Flying Cinnamon Ring', Event Exclusive Furniture 'Pastoral Sofa'
Phase 2
STARTS: March 7, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7)
CONTENTS: Event Exclusive Furniture 'Charming Fridge'
02 [ARKNIGHTS X SANRIO CHARACTERS] PACKS AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED TIME
DURATION: March 6, 2026, 08:00 - March 27, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
[Friends All Along Pack]
CONTENTS: Orundum * 400, Icon 'Fluffy Pink' * 1, Icon 'Warm Delivery' * 1, Icon 'Hunter's Calling?' * 1, Icon 'Adventure, away!' * 1
[Time Spent Together Pack]
CONTENTS: Orundum * 400, Icon 'Unspoken Bonds' * 1, Icon 'Elves' Nap' * 1, Icon 'Star of Encounters' * 1, Icon 'Star of Blessing' * 1
[Heart-warming Reunion Pack]
CONTENTS: Orundum * 1600, Home Screen UI 'Gathered Together' * 1
[Partners Commemorative Pack]
CONTENTS: Orundum * 400, Icon 'Detective Team' * 1, Icon 'Eureka's Dream' * 1, Icon 'No Chitchat, Thx' * 1, Icon 'Ribbon Exchange' * 1
[Friendship Commemorative Pack]
CONTENTS: Orundum * 400, Icon 'Wink—' * 1, Icon 'Silent Us' * 1, Icon 'I Like Your Skull' * 1, Icon 'Angel on the Cloud' * 1
[Honey Party Pack]
CONTENTS: Orundum * 1600, Themed Background 'Sweetness' * 1
Note:
Players who have already purchased [Partners Commemorative Pack], [Friendship Commemorative Pack], and [Honey Party Pack] cannot purchase them again.
03 [ARKNIGHTS X SANRIO CHARACTERS] COLLAB OUTFITS NOW AVAILABLE
DURATION: March 6, 2026, 08:00 - March 27, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7) DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
CROSSOVER Collection - Wanderer in the Rain for Lumen
CROSSOVER Collection - Fluffy Little Witch for Eyjafjalla
CROSSOVER Collection - The Train Runner for Executor the Ex Foedere
Note:
[Outfit Voucher] cannot be used to redeem the collab Outfits.

To better match the Sanrio characters' style, the sound effects for the following Outfits will be adjusted: [CROSSOVER Collection - The Train Runner for Executor the Ex Foedere], [CROSSOVER Collection - Fluffy Little Witch for Eyjafjalla], and [CROSSOVER Collection - Party In The Garden for Goldenglow].
